audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[1].why says 'Dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade.' Ambessa's passive does not shield.
audit.why: Drakehound's Step grants a dash plus bonus range, damage and attack speed on her NEXT ATTACK, and refunds energy — no shield anywhere. Her only shield is Repudiation (W), and it is not a passive-stacking effect: it shields, braces, then slams, and the slam is amplified by non-minion damage blocked during the brace. Against a Teemo whose whole early game is Toxic Shot poison chip, that is the single most valuable line in the matchup and it was replaced by a fabricated passive shield.
audit.corrected: Repudiation (W), 18/17/16/15/14: shield + brace + slam, amplified by damage blocked in the brace. Bracing his poke is the correct play.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json — P Drakehound's Step (no shield), W Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart is named repeatedly but its cooldown and its actual scope are never given.
audit.why: It is 7 seconds FLAT at every rank — a fixed, countable window, not a scaling one, which makes 'engage when it is down' an exact instruction instead of a vibe. Just as important, blind removes basic attacks only: Cunning Sweep, Lacerate and Public Execution all land through it. The entry treats the blind as if it shuts Ambessa off entirely, which pushes the player into passivity they do not need.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart (Q), 7s flat at all ranks, 680 range. It costs you the Drakehound's Step attack; Q, E and R resolve normally.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json — Q Blinding Dart cooldown '7' (single value), range 680

audit.whatIsWrong: Toxic Shot is called 'E poison' and never identified as an on-hit, attack-speed-scaling magic source; the itemization line says 'build MR' without connecting the two.
audit.why: Toxic Shot applies on-hit on every attack and ticks for 4 seconds, so his damage grows with attack speed and Element of Surprise off Guerrilla Warfare. Reading the trade through armour is the classic error here. It also means his poke is a stream of small non-minion hits — exactly what Repudiation's brace converts into an amplified slam.
audit.corrected: Toxic Shot (E) is on-hit magic damage over 4s, scaling with his attack speed — Mercury's plus MR, not armour, and his chip feeds your Repudiation brace.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json — E Toxic Shot, flags onHit; P Guerrilla Warfare Element of Surprise attack speed

audit.why: HARD at 8.5/10 with the lane conceded at 4-5 and reopened at 6 matches the kit maths: Blinding Dart erases her attack-based burst until Public Execution gives her a gap-close that the blind cannot touch. The content layer already describes this arc accurately. No side changed, and the win[] array already agrees stage-for-stage with the audited Teemo page.

The four spikes (Lvl 3, Lvl 6, 1st item, Late) are the right four and the reasoning holds. Level 3 is when Q into Sundering Slam, Lacerate and the dash all exist; level 6 is the blind-proof gap-close; Eclipse plus level-9 Q max is the damage peak; late is Teemo's map game. I only tightened the ability naming inside them.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is generic boilerplate: 'Your committal tool: never spend it on chip.'
audit.why: It names no cooldown and gives no number, in a matchup that turns entirely on one 7-second timer. Her own punishable window is also unnamed: Repudiation is 18s at rank 1, so a wasted brace is the longest hole in her kit early.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart 7s flat; Repudiation 18s at rank 1 is her longest early hole.

audit.whatIsWrong: Guerrilla Warfare is never mentioned in either layer.
audit.why: Teemo goes invisible standing still, and stays invisible while moving in brush — Ambessa carries no reveal, so a bush she wants to dash through is a coin flip, and he exits it with bonus attack speed from Element of Surprise. That is the mechanism behind 'don't facecheck', and stating the mechanism is worth more than the warning.
audit.corrected: Guerrilla Warfare: invisible standing still, and invisible while moving in brush. He leaves it with bonus attack speed.
